messages:
emma: opened PR 4144 to split the HSM/KMS section into two pages: 'hardware-hsm' and 'network-kms-proxy'. want reviews @rick @priya
rick: agree split makes sense. can we also add a tiny Python SDK example that shows using a local kms-proxy over TLS? many customers ask for that.
priya: also please shrink the network matrix for the hardware page. minimal hardware-only install should only list: SSH(22) and HTTPS(443) and optionally unix socket for HSM. remove all observability/tracing ports.
emma: noted. adding an example python client: `requests` snippet below and a sample cert verify step.
emma: ```python
import requests
r = requests.post('https://127.0.0.1:8443/sign', json={'data':'...'}, verify='/etc/kms/ca.pem', cert=('/etc/kms/client.crt','/etc/kms/client.key'))
print(r.json())
```
rick: good. add a short paragraph about TLS pinning for airgapped teams and warning about self-signed certs: verify file must be provided.
priya: HSM page should include device-bind options for container runtimes and a systemd unit example to bind device nodes for non-privileged installs.
priya: systemd drop-in: `BindPaths=/dev/eph-hsm:/dev/pkcs11` and note podman rootless won't accept device mounts unless using privileged helper.
infra-qa: linkcheck flagged `/internal/docs/hsm` -> change to `/docs/private/hardware-hsm.md`. also add `ci/docs-smoke-112` to smoke-tests matrix.
security: quick note: do not show full PKCS11 paths in public docs; use placeholders and include common vendor examples (SoftHSM: `/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so`, Thales: `/opt/thales/lib/libecryptoki.so`). add a reminder to never check certs/keys into repo.
emma: adding a tiny udev rule example for permissions: `KERNEL=="pkcs11", MODE="0660", GROUP="hsm"` and SELinux tip: `chcon -t container_file_t /dev/pkcs11`.
priya: include nftables minimal rule + iptables fallback. nftables: `nft add table inet redwood && nft add chain inet redwood forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; policy drop; } && nft add rule inet redwood forward tcp dport {443,22} accept && nft add rule inet redwood forward ct state established,related accept`
priya: iptables fallback: `iptables -A FORWARD -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT; iptables -A FORWARD -p tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT; iptables -A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT; iptables -P FORWARD DROP`
docs-bot: reminder: add changelog header "Docs: split HSM/KMS pages (PR 4144)" and ensure smoke-tests `ci/docs-smoke-112` present. re-run linkcheck on push.
emma: will push fixes for links, changelog, python snippet, and vendor examples. tagging this thread for final review. closed after CI passes :white_check_mark:
